 Shapiro favors minimum wage hike over more progressive items if Democrats sweep Pennsylvania midterms
 By Emily Hallas 
 Published
 October 30, 2026 2:05pm ET
 | 
 Updated
 October 30, 2026 2:05pm ET
 Advertisement -->
 Advertisement 
 Add Washington Examiner on Google
 Advertisement 
 Gov. Josh Shapiro (D-PA) this week suggested he’ll stay away from pushing progressive priorities in Pennsylvania if Democrats hit a trifecta in the battleground state’s upcoming midterm elections.
 Democrats currently control the governor’s seat and the state legislature’s lower chamber. Should his party secure power over the state Senate as well on Tuesday, Shapiro told Semafor he wouldn’t focus on advancing a stream of progressive bills, as Democrats in some swing states have done after winning the legislature.
